newsitem.title: TURKEY: Sixteen died in Turkey's Kurd conflict.
newsitem.headline: Sixteen died in Turkey's Kurd conflict.

text.p: Turkish security forces killed 10 Kurdish guerrillas on Tuesday in an attack on rebel positions in the southeast of the country, the emergency rule governor's office said in a statement.
The statement said the troops launched an operation backed by Sikorsky helicopters against the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) guerrillas in the province of Diyarbakir.
It did not give any figures for military casualties.
Anatolian news agency said earlier that two rebels were killed in a clash in the province of Adiyaman on Monday.
It also said three civilians and a soldier died on Monday in a separate clash when the PKK fired at a small lorry carrying villagers.
More than 21,000 people have died in the 12-year-old conflict between troops and the PKK, fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly-Kurdish southeast.
